title: 表达感受与看法

sentenceFrames.usage: 说出真实的、可能跟别人不一样的想法。"To be honest" 是一个信号——接下来的话是真诚的。
sentenceFrames.example: To be honest, I wasn't really that excited about it at first. But it grew on me.
substitutions: To be honest, I **was a bit disappointed when...
To be honest, I **don't really get the hype about _____ (某个流行事物).
To be honest, I **was pretty nervous about speaking English before I started practicing.
To be honest, I **think _____ is overrated.

sentenceFrames.usage: 用比喻来表达感受，比"it makes me feel..."生动得多。
sentenceFrames.example: Speaking English for the first time feels like learning to walk again — you know what you want to do, but your body won't cooperate.
substitutions: Starting a new job** feels like **being the new kid at school.
A long weekend** feels like **a mini vacation for your brain.
Trying to speak a new language** feels like _____.

sentenceFrames.usage: 表达一种你"忍不住这么觉得"的看法。比 "I think" 有情感温度。
sentenceFrames.example: I can't help but feel that we spend way too much time on our phones and not enough time actually talking to each other.
substitutions: I can't help but feel that **time is passing faster every year.
I can't help but feel that **most meetings could have been emails.
I can't help but feel that _____.
I can't help but feel that _____.
I can't help but think that _____. (think 也可以替换 feel)
